title: Select the Rust 2024 edition in Cargo manifests
abstract: When selecting an edition for a Rust package, use the fixed Cargo.toml [package].edition value "2024". The normative force is deliberately left open for analysis: it might mandate that value or merely permit it.

provisional_conflict_analysis.reason: Presently 2024 is the latest documented stable Rust edition. If a newer edition becomes applicable, mandatory fixed-2024 and mandatory latest-edition obligations can be incompatible, but a weaker permissive or advisory formulation need not be.

unresolved: Determine whether this is an obligation, strong/weak permission, or recommendation.
Determine whether a later edition and this fixed value may coexist as alternatives, or the setting must equal exactly one value.
Evaluate possible conflict only under overlapping project scope and temporal conditions.

public_reference_context.observed_fact: Rust 2024 is currently documented as the latest stable Cargo edition, so these proposals are not presently value-incompatible solely on the edition year.
public_reference_context.note: Observation is temporal background, not frozen normative content; latest stable may change in the future.
